title: Stable role identity and task reconciliation
requirement: In autolabel_pipeline and every workspace, a delegated role must have one explicit valid preset, the orchestrator must not offer ambiguous or preset-less legacy roles for reuse, and an active task whose child ended in error must not remain silently active.
steps: Run `node scripts/taskboard-role-proof.mjs`: it drives the real taskboard service (registerAgent/findAgent/childEnded/reconcile) and the orchestrator's renderRoleCatalog/presetForRole/canReuseAgent on a disposable board.

Register AUDIT with preset reviewer, then AUDIT with preset critic: the second call must be refused with `preset_conflict` and the row must keep `reviewer`/its session. `force: true` is the recorded exception.
Reset the board with a preset-less DASHBOARD row: `findAgent` must report `legacy: true`, `canReuseAgent` must be false, and an explicit `preset` must adopt it once with an `adoptedAt` history entry.

Render the catalog for BACKEND[backend] twice, AUDIT[reviewer] + AUDIT[critic], and DASHBOARD[legacy]: one line per pair, an 'ambiguous' sentence naming REVIEWER/CRITIC, and a separate 'Legacy roles (history only - do not reuse)' section.
Settle a linked child with stopReason `error`: the task must become `blocked` with that reason; stopReason `stop` must still become `review`.

Rewrite the board so a settled-child task is back in `active` next to one with a live child, then call `reconcile`: the stale row becomes `blocked`, the live row stays `active`, and a second call reports `fixed: 0`.

Prove the check can fail: extract the pre-fix modules (`git show HEAD:plugins/taskboard/taskboard.mjs`, `.../orchestrator.mjs`) and run the same script with --taskboard/--orchestrator pointing at them - it must exit 1 with the defect lines.
expected: `node scripts/taskboard-role-proof.mjs` prints 15/15 checks passed and exits 0, and the same run against the pre-fix modules exits 1 with at least the preset_conflict, legacy, catalog and blocked-on-error lines failing. Operationally on autolabel_pipeline: every reusable role reports exactly one preset, AUDIT is split into REVIEWER and CRITIC, preset-less rows are marked legacy and refused for reuse with their tasks intact, and an active task whose child ended in error is blocked with that reason rather than left active.

snapshot.title: Stable role identity and task reconciliation
snapshot.requirement: In autolabel_pipeline and every workspace, a delegated role must have one explicit valid preset, the orchestrator must not offer ambiguous or preset-less legacy roles for reuse, and an active task whose child ended in error must not remain silently active.
snapshot.expected: Every reusable role reports exactly one valid preset; ambiguous duplicates and legacy preset-less roles are visibly retired or blocked from reuse; failed children produce an explicit blocked/stale task state with evidence; historical tasks and results remain intact.
steps: Open the autolabel_pipeline Tasks panel and inspect the role catalog.
Verify AUDIT is split into unambiguous REVIEWER and CRITIC identities with one preset each.
Verify custom roles resolve through the workspace role registry and cannot silently borrow backend.
Verify legacy preset-less roles are excluded from reuse while historical tasks remain readable.
Inspect an active task whose child stopped with error: it must be reconciled to blocked/stale or restarted, not left silently active.
Attempt a conflicting role/preset registration and confirm it is refused.
snapshot.reason: Acceptance requires live taskboard, role registry, delegation and second-server UI behavior; the implementation task is not complete yet, so no runnable surface or observed verification exists.
